source.title: Blood pressure and glycaemic effects of dapagliflozin versus placebo in patients with type 2 diabetes on combination antihypertensive therapy: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 study

source_consistency_findings.issue: thiazide subgroup seated-SBP CI text-extraction sign conflict
source_consistency_findings.resolution: Main-article abstract/summary and the rendered Figure 3 support an upper CI bound of +1.40 mm Hg; this value was retained. No numeric correction beyond source reconciliation was made.

limitations: No primary-study facts were inferred from the bibliography.
Post-hoc subgroup results are tagged and appraised as exploratory heterogeneity signals.
Calculated absolute risk differences and lab arm-change differences are explicitly labeled calculated_from_reported_data.
